correctness.rationale: The proof establishes the exact difference GCD through fourth-order unit-constant recurrences and four initial terms, then uses a Pell telescoping identity and a dyadic shift/lifting argument to compute every prime valuation of the initial-window GCD. Direct exact arithmetic checked 500 k values, with the infinite result following from symbolic identities.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The new formula implies and sharply strengthens 4|b^2(k) for all k. The prior observation alone is consistent with infinitely many GCD possibilities and cannot recover the 5k, Pell, 2-adic or 7-adic factors. The first-power or Fibonacci-family theorems cannot yield it by parameter substitution.

originality.rationale: The 2023 primary article explicitly poses the squared-cobalancing GCD as Question 30 and records only a factor-of-four divisibility. Its materially inspected full journal text does not prove this exact formula. The 2022 general-Gibonacci square result addresses a distinct homogeneous recurrence and does not imply the affine cobalancing formula. Targeted research-record and literature searches yielded no covering result; an unindexed equivalent remains a residual risk.

value.rationale: This determines the entire all-k squared-cobalancing branch of JIS 2023 Question 30, strengthening a stated factor-four divisibility to an explicit Pell/k GCD with exact exceptional 2- and 7-factors. It replaces infinitely many shifted sums by two explicit natural integers and resolves a motivated published gap.
